solutions.pageIntro: IRON GPS launches with four deliberately focused solutions, grouped into two lines: IRON FLEET, for intelligence and control of commercial fleets; and IRON SECURITY, for electronic protection of higher-risk assets.
solutions.lineFleetDesc: Intelligence and control for commercial fleets. Turns vehicle data into actionable information: route compliance, usage, driver behavior and fuel and cargo control.
solutions.lineSecurityDesc: Electronic protection for mobile assets. Combines physical security with telematics and IoT: location informs, control acts and prior validation reduces risk.

items.q: What vehicles and assets can I manage?
items.a: Personal, commercial and cargo vehicles, transport, enterprise fleets, machinery and high-value assets — with or without GPS via BLE technology.

items.q: Does IRON GPS work for small businesses?
items.a: Yes. IRON TRACK is designed as an entry point for a few vehicles, and the solution scales as you grow.

items.q: Can I manage a large fleet?
items.a: Yes. The platform is scalable and ready for operations with many assets and users.

items.q: Can I see my vehicles in real time?
items.a: Yes, from the web platform and the native iOS and Android apps.

items.q: Can I get alerts and review history?
items.a: Yes. You set event-based alerts and review trips and historical data whenever you need.

items.q: Can I manage different vehicle types at once?
items.a: Yes. A single account can combine vehicles, fleets and assets of different types.

items.q: Will it alert me when insurance or inspection expires?
items.a: Yes. The platform manages document expirations (insurance, technical inspection, licenses) and alerts you in advance to avoid fines and penalties.

about.title: About us
about.heading: We exist to close the gap between having GPS and having control.
about.intro: Most companies with GPS today know where their vehicle is, but not whether it's being used properly, whether there's a risk of loss, or whether a driver has risky behavior. That's the gap IRON GPS exists to close.
about.narrativeQuote: At IRON GPS we believe managing a vehicle shouldn't just mean knowing where it is. It should mean being in control.
narrative: We were founded to close a very specific gap: many companies and people already have a GPS, but still don't have answers. They don't know if a vehicle is being used properly, if there's a risk of loss, if a driver has dangerous behavior, or if an operation could run more efficiently. They have a dot on a map, but not control.

IRON GPS exists to turn that information into decisions. We are a Colombian company, based in Barranquilla with coverage across the country, specialized in the intelligent management of vehicles, fleets and assets. We bring together the technology platform, our own installation, monitoring and support in a single service — so our clients don't have to piece it together from multiple providers.

We see technology as a means, not an end. That's why we offer two paths depending on the operation: a client can self-manage everything from our platform and apps, or rely on our monitoring center to watch and respond on their behalf. Either way, the goal is the same: more security, more control and better decisions.

We are building long-term relationships, not one-off sales. And we are building a company that grows: today, vehicle and fleet management; tomorrow, telematics, IoT, video telemetry, analytics and new solutions that keep giving our clients control over what matters most to them.
about.purpose: That every person and every company has real control over what matters most to them. We believe technology exists to give peace of mind: knowing your vehicles, cargo and assets are protected, and that every decision is made with information, not uncertainty.
about.mission: We help people and companies protect and manage their vehicles, fleets and assets, turning the information they generate into decisions that increase their safety, control and efficiency. We do this with reliable technology, our own installation and monitoring, and close support at every stage.
about.vision: By 2030, IRON GPS will be a reference company in intelligent mobility and asset management in Colombia, with national presence and thousands of vehicles and assets connected to our platform. We will have started our regional expansion into Ecuador and Panama, and will be recognized for turning data into decisions, for the security we give our clients, and for long-term relationships.
